reasons: Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Introduce CleanShot Pro to an IT/ops buyer as the tier that lets them buy team seats at $10 per user/month billed annually and set up SSO, SCIM and admin controls in CleanShot Cloud to manage team access centrally, with the single next step of starting an evaluation covered by the 30-day money-back guarantee (there is no free trial; refunds are requested from support).

allowed_claims: CleanShot offers a 30-day money-back guarantee
CleanShot can add a webcam bubble to a screen recording so people see you, not just your screen
CleanShot can capture scrolling content such as full pages, long chats, documents, and code that stretch beyond the screen in one screenshot
CleanShot's Background Tool includes 20 beautiful backgrounds for turning screenshots into polished visuals
CleanShot can read QR codes instantly via on-device text recognition
CleanShot requires macOS 13.0 or newer
CleanShot offers no free trial but has a 30-day money-back guarantee, while Setapp offers CleanShot with a 7-day free trial
CleanShot offers a 30% educational discount to students with an edu-issued email
CleanShot does not have a Windows version and there are no plans to release one
CleanShot 5.0 introduced Studio Mode, which lets users add animated zooms with smooth motion blur to screen recordings
CleanShot Basic is $35 one-time payment, pay once use forever, includes the Mac app, one year of updates, and 1 GB of Cloud storage

CleanShot Pro is $10 per user/month, billed annually (17% cheaper than monthly), and includes the Mac app always up to date, unlimited Cloud storage, custom domain and branding, team features, centralized access management, SSO and SCIM
CleanShot offers a 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee
After the first year of free updates expires, CleanShot Basic license holders can optionally renew updates for $19 per seat per year, or keep using the last version forever without renewing
Every CleanShot license includes 1 year of free updates from the purchase date
Active CleanShot Cloud Pro subscribers always get the latest version of the app with no need to renew updates
CleanShot Cloud is ISO 27001 certified
CleanShot Cloud supports SSO, SCIM, and admin controls to manage access as teams grow
CleanShot Cloud lets users add link expiration and password protection to shared captures
CleanShot Cloud recordings include searchable transcripts, captions, comments, and smooth playback
